body.title: Route approval requests through the queue in the panel
body.summary: Replace pendingPerms with the t1 queue in chat-panel.ts. runTurn's TurnSink.onEvent and followLiveTurn's FollowSink.onEvent enqueue approval-requests (classifying blockKind as today) instead of posting them, and post only the head card with position/total; every other event is posted and persisted as today. A batch ends on its turn's terminal event (done/error) or a followed turn's onEnd. Stop (cancel-turn) records each undecided request as rejected and clears the queue; a chat switch or panel close drops it without outcome rows.
acceptanceChecks: A turn raising three approval-requests posts exactly one card (the first) with position 1 of 3
A followed turn's approval-requests also go through the queue
Stop records each undecided request as rejected and clears the queue; open-chat / new-chat / dispose drop it with no outcome rows
approval-request is still never written to the transcript

tests.name: three requests in one turn: only the first card is posted (with '1 of 3')
a turn followed after reload routes its approval-requests through the queue and its end ends the batch
Stop with requests queued records each as rejected and clears the queue
outcome rows: one role:'permission-outcome' row per decision, in decision order, and no approval-request rows (restore shows only chips)
